title: Reinforced Saw
body:
"A powerful blacksteel saw, reinforced with Adurite found deep below the magma caves."

Description

The Reinforced Saw, available exclusively at The Oak Depot, commands a price tag of $12,000 . Renowned as one of the best Saw in the game a player can purchase.

Saws are tools used to cut off the bark of trees, increasing their price.

Appearance

Refined from the finest materials, the Reinforced Saw stands tall, crafted from blacksteel (a material yet to grace the realms of our game) and Adurite.

Trivia

- The Reinforced Saw, alongside its companions in the reinforced tool set, was introduced as part of the highly anticipated Progression Update.

- When introduced its original price was $266,000
